hints.title: Recursive Sequence Generation
hints.text: Generate a continuous series of integers starting from 1 up to the maximum customer_id in Customers using a recursive CTE.

hints.title: Excluding Present Customers
hints.text: Filter the generated integer sequence for numbers not present in Customers using not in or left join.

hints.title: Sorting Output
hints.text: Project the column named ids and order by ids in ascending order.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH RECURSIVE Sequence AS (
    SELECT 1 AS ids
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ids + 1 FROM Sequence WHERE ids < (SELECT MAX(customer_id) FROM Customers)
)
SELECT ids
FROM Sequence
WHERE ids NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM Customers)
ORDER BY ids ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Recursively builds continuous sequence up to M and filters present IDs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Static tables cannot generate arbitrary missing numbers without series generators.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursive CTE materializes exactly M numbers in memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recursive CTE sequence generation with anti-join predicate.
